  • Healthy Soils and Water for a Sustainable Environment

    UK registered businesses can apply for a share of up to £28 million for soil, water and environmental management. This funding is from Farming Futures R&D Fund.

    Eligibility

    This competition is open to collaborations only.

    To lead a collaborative project your organisation must be a UK registered business of any size and collaborate with at least one other UK organisation.

    Opening soon

    Opens:
    19 November 2026
    Closes:
    28 January 2027

  • Growth Cohorts: Next-gen low carbon concrete cohort entry Round 2

    UK registered businesses can apply to join a cohort of ambitious businesses. These businesses will develop solutions to decarbonise concrete and access funding and sector specific support, to develop and deliver innovation and growth plans.

    Eligibility

    This competition is open to single applicants only.

    To work alone your organisation must be a UK registered business of any size.

    Open now

    Opened:
    21 October 2026
    Closes:
    2 December 2026

  • BridgeAI Deployment Catalyst: AI for Operational Systems

    UK registered SMEs can apply for a share of up to £5 million to deploy Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions that perform, control or coordinate operational activity. Funding is from Innovate UK.

    Eligibility

    This competition is open to collaborative projects only.

    The lead must be a UK registered AI SME with an existing AI or ML solution at TRL 5 to 6.

    Each application must include one UK registered medium or large organisation as a deployer.

    You may include one additional project partner.

    The consortium must include two or three organisations only.

    Open now

    Opened:
    21 October 2026
    Closes:
    8 December 2026

  • BridgeAI Deployment Catalyst: AI for Decision Critical Systems

    UK registered SMEs can apply for a share of up to £5 million to deploy Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions that support consequential judgements, recommendations or decisions. Funding is from Innovate UK.

    Eligibility

    This competition is open to collaborative projects only.

    The lead must be a UK registered AI SME with an existing AI or ML solution at TRL 5 to 6.

    Each application must include one UK registered medium or large organisation as a deployer.

    You may include one additional project partner.

    The consortium must include two or three organisations only.

    Open now

    Opened:
    21 October 2026
    Closes:
    8 December 2026

  • BridgeAI Deployment Catalyst: AI for Assurance and Compliance

    UK registered SMEs can apply for a share of up to £5 million to deploy Artificial Intelligence and Machine Learning solutions that monitor, test, verify or evidence compliance with requirements, standards or controls. Funding is from Innovate UK.

    Eligibility

    This competition is open to collaborative projects only.

    The lead must be a UK registered AI SME with an existing AI or ML solution at TRL 5 to 6.

    Each application must include one UK registered medium or large organisation as a deployer.

    You may include one additional project partner.

    The consortium must include two or three organisations only.

    Open now

    Opened:
    21 October 2026
    Closes:
    8 December 2026

  • Knowledge Transfer Partnership (KTP): 2026 - 2027 Round 4

    UK registered academic institutions, RTOs or Catapults can apply for a share of up to £12.5 million to fund innovation projects with businesses.

    Eligibility

    To lead a project your organisation must:

    • be a UK registered higher education or further education institution, research and technology organisation (RTO) or Catapult
    • collaborate with a UK registered business of any size with two or more full time employees
    The business must contribute to the project’s costs.

    Open now

    Opened:
    19 October 2026
    Closes:
    27 January 2027

  • Efficient, Structured and Controllable AI Systems

    UK registered SME businesses can apply for a share of up to £1.66 million to deliver experimental validation of prototype AI systems for novel reusable components of efficient, structured and controllable learning systems.

    Eligibility

    This competition is open to single applicants.
    To work alone your organisation must be a UK registered micro, small or medium sized enterprise (SME).

    Open now

    Opened:
    12 October 2026
    Closes:
    18 November 2026

  • Full ADOPT Grant: Round 10

    Farming, growing or forestry businesses based in England can apply for a share of up to £5 million for on-farm trial and demonstration projects, to improve adoption of new ideas or solutions in the agricultural sector.

    Eligibility

    This competition is open to collaborations only.

    To lead a collaborative project your organisation must:

    • be an active farming, growing or forestry business of any size based in England
    • be able to evidence that you are an established business, including sole traders and partnerships
    • collaborate with at least one other farming business of any size based in the UK

    Open now

    Opened:
    8 October 2026
    Closes:
    2 December 2026

  • FOAK Builder: Programme Entry Expression of Interest

    UK registered businesses can apply for support worth up to £315,000 to develop a Climate Tech First-of-a-Kind (FOAK) project. Companies successful at this EOI stage could be invited to apply for a larger grant through FOAK Builder Phase 2.

    Eligibility

    This competition is open to single applicants only.

    To work alone your organisation must be a UK registered micro, small or medium sized enterprise (SME).

    Your company must be at the appropriate stage in developing a climate tech FOAK commercial project of the scale and scope described.

    Closing soon

    Opened:
    7 October 2026
    Closes:
    5 November 2026

  • Eureka collaborative R&D: Globalstars Japan 2027

    UK registered organisations can apply for a share of £2 million for collaborative industrial research projects with partners from Japan and select Eureka countries.

    Eligibility

    This competition is open to collaborations only.

    To be eligible for grant funding your collaboration:

    • must include at least one UK registered business of any size
    • must collaborate with a Japan registered SME as a minimum
    • can include other organisations from participating Eureka countries
    • can include other UK registered organisations

    Open now

    Opened:
    7 October 2026
    Closes:
    20 January 2027
